brand_identity.emotional_tone: Clean, Trustworthy, Cutting-edge Enterprise, Polish & Strategic Depth
brand_identity.visual_motif: Connected nodes / molecular network SVG geometry + subtle glowing interactive dots

headline_rules.H1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-[#1F3A5F]
headline_rules.H2: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[#1F3A5F]
headline_rules.Subtitle: text-lg sm:text-xl text-slate-600 leading-relaxed font-normal

typography.font_sources: Import Google Fonts: 'Plus Jakarta Sans:wght@400;500;600;700;800', 'Poppins:wght@600;700;800', and 'Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700' in index.html or index.css

usage_rules.red_accent: CRITICAL: Reserved ONLY for CTA buttons (e.g. main contact CTA, red badge in navbar), highlighted keywords/underlines, and small badges. NEVER use red as a large section background.
usage_rules.navy: Used for main section headings, dark footer background, and deep structural elements.
usage_rules.gradient: Use 135deg gradient #1E88E5 -> #4FC3F7 for hero badge highlights, secondary CTA buttons, stats counters background, and border beam lines.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Use generous 2-3x padding: sections py-20 lg:py-32, container px-6 sm:px-12 lg:px-16 max-w-7xl mx-auto
layout_and_spacing.hero_overlay: Light, subtle gradient overlay over interactive SVG canvas so nodes and text contrast cleanly without dark murky standard overlays.

motion_and_interactivity.smooth_scroll: Lenis smooth momentum scrolling initialized globally on main container
motion_and_interactivity.hero_reveal: Masked line-by-line staggered entrance reveal using Framer Motion (initial y:40, opacity:0 -> animate y:0, opacity:1)
motion_and_interactivity.molecular_bg: Animated SVG Canvas/Node component with floating node points, connecting laser lines, mouse repulsion/proximity micro-effect
motion_and_interactivity.marquee: Slow editorial marquee band ('react-fast-marquee' or CSS continuous marquee) showing key clients, tech frameworks, and partner badges with low-contrast neutral palette
motion_and_interactivity.scroll_reveal: Framer Motion 'whileInView' viewport reveal with once:true, margin:'-100px', duration:0.6s
motion_and_interactivity.hover_effects: Micro-tilt on card hovers (transform translate-y-[-6px] + glow border), scale up CTA buttons on hover (hover:scale-[1.02] active:scale-[0.98])

routes.type: Single-page landing with smooth scroll anchors (#about, #products, #portfolio, #services, #why-us, #process, #contact)
Dedicated product detail page for Jewelry Management System (POS, Gold Rate Live Ticker, Stock Tracking, Consignment, Multi-branch)
Dedicated product detail page for Loge Knowledge AI (Enterprise RAG, Vector Knowledge Search, PDF & Document Assistant, Security Governance)

bilingual_configuration.implementation: React state or i18n context controlling dictionaries for all text, headings, badges, product features, and form labels.

sticky_navbar.features: Glassmorphic background (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-blue-100/50), Brand Logo (Molecular icon + ARRAYA red wordmark + PARTNER WAMYS navy tagline), Nav links (Beranda, Tentang, Produk, Portofolio, Layanan, Kontak), Language Toggle pills (ID | EN), Red CTA button ('Hubungi Kami' / 'Contact Us')
sticky_navbar.mobile_nav: Responsive slide-down drawer with clear dark backdrop and touch-friendly links.

contact_form_and_details.features: Form with client-side validation (Name, Email, Phone, Company, Service interest, Message), integration to FastAPI backend /api/contact endpoint, toast feedback via Sonner, Google Map iframe/placeholder styled with custom map pins, clear direct contact info (Email, Phone, Office Address in Jakarta/Indonesia), floating action WhatsApp button with direct message pre-filled link.

footer.content: ARRAYA molecular logo, company summary, quick navigation links, product list links, legal terms, and copyright text.

testing_attributes.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements, buttons, links, inputs, language switches, modal controls, product links, and form submit elements MUST have data-testid in kebab-case format.

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow this design guideline strictly. Build a stunning, top 1% corporate website for PT Arraya Mitra Informatika.
Install and integrate `@studio-freight/lenis` or `lenis` for momentum smooth scrolling.
Use Lucide-react icons for clear, crisp iconography.
Ensure complete bilingual support (ID/EN) with instant state switching.
Ensure all product sub-routes (/products/jewelry-management and /products/loge-knowledge-ai) are fully functional with back navigation, deep feature breakdowns, ROI metrics, and contact CTAs.
Use Sonner for toast alerts upon contact form submission.
Maintain high APCA contrast ratios. Red button text must be white (#FFFFFF), navbar text on white header must be navy (#1F3A5F).
Include data-testid on every clickable or input component.
